import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { execFileSync, spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const inspect=(name)=>JSON.parse(execFileSync('docker',['inspect',name],{encoding:'utf8'}))[0];
const receipts=[];
for(const [service,port] of [['server',4521],['worker',4442]]){
 const name=`nibleaf-runtime-${service}-1`;
 const before=inspect(name);
 assert.equal(before.Config.Labels['com.docker.compose.project'],'nibleaf-runtime');
 assert.equal(before.Config.Labels['com.docker.compose.service'],service);
 assert.equal(before.Config.StopTimeout,30);
 assert.equal(before.State.Running,true);
 const health=await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/health`);assert.equal(health.status,200);
 const since=new Date().toISOString();const started=performance.now();
 execFileSync('docker',['stop','--timeout','30',name],{stdio:'pipe'});
 const elapsedMs=Math.round(performance.now()-started);const after=inspect(name);
 assert.equal(after.State.ExitCode,0);assert.equal(after.State.Running,false);assert.equal(after.State.OOMKilled,false);
 assert.ok(elapsedMs<10000,`${service} stop exceeded ten seconds: ${elapsedMs}ms`);
 const logs=spawnSync('docker',['logs','--since',since,name],{encoding:'utf8'});assert.equal(logs.status,0);
 receipts.push({service,imageId:before.Image,sourceRevision:before.Config.Labels['org.opencontainers.image.revision'],composeStopWindowSeconds:before.Config.StopTimeout,elapsedMs,exitCode:after.State.ExitCode,oomKilled:after.State.OOMKilled,shutdownLogs:(logs.stdout+logs.stderr).trim()});
}
const report={project:'nibleaf-runtime',observedAt:new Date().toISOString(),receipts};
writeFileSync(process.argv[2],JSON.stringify(report,null,2)+'\n');console.log(JSON.stringify(report));
